title: get_property_reads input
description: Imported runtime property reads by endpoint or by entity, independent of table mapping (A30): which entity properties an endpoint was seen reading, which endpoints read a property, what the ORM loaded that no code used, and which mapped properties no import mentions. Observed in a window, never load from code. With an endpoint, also the static side: entity properties read on resolved paths from it (static reach, not load), the unresolved calls that bound that answer, and how it compares with imported application reads.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

endpoint.description: An endpoint qualified name, such as `GET api/Orders/{id}`.

entity.description: An entity qualified name (runtime type or declaring type), such as `Shop.Data.Order`.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.
